career_ladder.note: Graduate Trainees (GTs) in Engineering and Geo-Sciences in ONGC are inducted in Executive Grade E-1 and undergo 1 year of training and probation. Upon successful completion of training, they are regularized as Assistant Executive Engineers (AEE) or equivalent officers in Grade E-1, advancing through the technical and managerial hierarchies up to Executive Director and Board-level appointments.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Graduate Trainees in ONGC is conducted through Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) score in the relevant discipline followed by Personal Interview and evaluation of academic credentials. The final selection matrix assigns 60 marks to GATE score, 25 marks to Academic Qualification (20 marks for essential qualification + 5 marks for inline M.Tech/Ph.D), and 15 marks to Personal Interview.

financial_package.note: Compensation is governed by DPE 3rd Pay Revision Committee (PRC) guidelines for Maharatna CPSEs. Graduate Trainees in ONGC receive starting basic pay of ₹60,000 in Grade E-1, mandatory 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, cafeteria approach allowances @ 35% of basic pay, HRA (9% to 27%), substantial offshore / drilling allowances for offshore postings, performance-related pay (PRP), CPF, and medical coverage. Approximate annual Cost to Company (CTC) is ₹20 to ₹22 Lakhs.
financial_package.pay_source_label: ONGC Terms of Appointment & E-1 Remuneration Scale
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Entry Basic Pay of ₹60,000, 58% IDA (₹34,800), Cafeteria perks @ 35% (₹21,000), and HRA (9% to 27% = ₹5,400 to ₹16,200), plus offshore allowances for offshore operational shifts, less statutory deductions for Contributory Provident Fund (12% of Basic + DA = ₹11,376), Post-Retirement Benefit Scheme, and income tax.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised quarterly per AICPI
Perks and Allowances under Cafeteria Approach @ 35% of Basic Pay
Offshore Hardship / Shift Allowance for offshore platforms and deepwater drilling operations
House Rent Allowance (HRA) @ 9%, 18%, or 27% / ONGC township residential colonies
Performance Related Pay (PRP) linked to individual score and corporate performance
Contributory Provident Fund (CPF), Gratuity, and Composite Social Security Scheme
Comprehensive medical treatment for employee and dependents in ONGC hospitals and empaneled multi-specialty centers
Conveyance Maintenance Reimbursement and uniform/safety gear allowances
